description: Home & Accounts cluster (plan items 1-6, 10): (a) extract the Home 'Edit balance' showFieldsSheet flow into a shared helper and add an 'Adjust balance' affordance to each Accounts-management row that records the SAME adjustment via homeControllerProvider.updateAccountBalance; (b) add a pure 'bills due this week' selector over recurringListProvider.nextDueDate and surface a conditional 'N bills due this week' attention item on Home (tap -> RecurringPaymentsScreen), ordered SMS -> bills-due -> budget-exceeded, with the zone still collapsing when all are clear; (c) introduce a single composed homeOverviewProvider snapshot (total balance + this-month income/expense/net + pending SMS count + bills-due count + exceeded budgets) that composes EXISTING providers (no new SQL) and is read by the hero total, month strip, and attention zone so they never momentarily disagree, preserving skipLoadingOnReload no-flicker. These items share home_screen.dart and the attention zone and are one coherent unit. NO DB migration/schema changes; raise a warning first if any seems needed.
steps: Read .agents/tasks/mykhata-phase4-ux/context.json and this FEAT file FIRST; context.json replaces re-exploration. Also read .agents/tasks/mykhata-phase4-ux/plan.md items 1-6 for the authoritative detail.

Item 1: Create lib/presentation/screens/settings/account_balance_actions.dart with a top-level `Future<void> editAccountBalance(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref, AccountModel account)` that reproduces Home's current _editBalance (showFieldsSheet title 'Edit {name} balance', submit 'Save balance', single numeric required field initial = currentBalance.toStringAsFixed(2); parse with double.tryParse(replaceAll(',','')) ; call ref.read(homeControllerProvider.notifier).updateAccountBalance(account.id, newBalance); same snackbars 'Adjustment recorded for {name}' / 'Could not update {name} balance' and the invalid-amount snackbar). Do NOT duplicate adjustment math — it stays in homeControllerProvider.

Item 1: In lib/presentation/screens/home/home_screen.dart replace the body of _editBalance to delegate to editAccountBalance(context, ref, account); keep the hero account-chip wiring (onEditAccount) intact.

Item 2: In lib/presentation/screens/settings/accounts_management_screen.dart add an 'Adjust balance' affordance to each row — give the ListRowTile an onTap calling editAccountBalance(context, ref, acc); keep the existing trailing star (primary) and delete IconButtons. (ConsumerWidget already has ref.)

Item 3: Add a pure top-level `int dueWithinDays(List<RecurringPaymentModel> items, {int days = 7, DateTime? now})` in lib/presentation/providers/recurring_providers.dart: let startOfToday = DateTime(n.year,n.month,n.day); count items where isActive && !nextDueDate.isBefore(startOfToday) && !nextDueDate.isAfter(startOfToday.add(Duration(days: days))). Export a list variant too if convenient. No persisted fields.

Item 4: Add test/unit/recurring_due_test.dart (mirror test/unit/transaction_calculation_test.dart) covering: due today counts; due in exactly 7 days counts; due in 8 days excluded; due yesterday excluded; inactive excluded; empty -> 0. Construct RecurringPaymentModel inline, no DB.

Item 6: Create lib/presentation/providers/home_overview_provider.dart with an immutable `HomeOverview` class (double totalBalance, monthIncome, monthExpense, monthNet; int pendingSmsCount, billsDueCount; List<BudgetModel> exceededBudgets) and a Provider `homeOverviewProvider` that COMPOSES existing providers via ref.watch (accountListProvider fold for totalBalance; homeMonthSummaryProvider for the month figures; smsQueueProvider('detected') length; dueWithinDays over recurringListProvider; budgetListProvider filtered by overAmount>0 || usedRatio>=1.0). Must NOT run new SQL. Extract the pure combine step (inputs -> HomeOverview) into a top-level function so it is unit-testable. Preserve the month strip's skipLoadingOnReload no-flicker behavior (carry AsyncValue state or keep _ThisMonthStrip reading homeMonthSummaryProvider through the snapshot).

Item 5 + 6 rewire: In home_screen.dart compute attention state and the hero total + month figures from homeOverviewProvider (widgets stay dumb). Add a compact tappable _BillsDueAttentionCard modeled on _SmsAttentionCard/_BudgetAlertCard (AppCard, 44x44 leading chip, title 'N bills due this week', subtitle 'Tap to review upcoming payments', chevron) that AppRoutes.push(context, const RecurringPaymentsScreen()) on tap. Order attention items SMS -> bills due -> budget exceeded, each emitted only when its condition holds, keeping the existing const SizedBox(height:14) separators so the zone still collapses to nothing when all clear. Keep the 'Upcoming recurring' section exactly as-is. Recent-transactions + full recurring section MAY keep their own providers.
Item 6 test: add test/unit/home_overview_test.dart asserting the pure combine function (exceeded-budget predicate + bills-due count + total-balance fold + month-net) given fixture lists/values.

Confirm Home's refresh() and transaction_providers _refreshDependents() still cover every input of homeOverviewProvider (accountListProvider, homeMonthSummaryProvider, budgetListProvider, recurringListProvider, smsQueueProvider) so one mutation updates hero + strip + attention together. Add any missing invalidation only if a gap is found; do not change number meanings.
Item 10 (scoped to this FEAT's files): run flutter analyze and flutter test; run `dart format` on every file you changed/created and accept the reflow.

Set this FEAT status to completed in features/FEAT-001.json and record in findings: the shared helper file path, the dueWithinDays signature, the HomeOverview field list + homeOverviewProvider name, and any invalidation you added — FEAT-002 and the convergence step rely on these.
Commit locally on redesign/mykhata-2.0 (stage only the files you touched; never `git add .`); do NOT push.
acceptance_criteria: Tapping an account row on the Accounts management screen opens the same 'Edit balance' sheet Home uses and records an adjustment via homeControllerProvider.updateAccountBalance (not a silent set); the Home account-chip adjustment still works via the shared helper.

Home shows an 'N bills due this week' attention item only when >=1 active recurring payment has nextDueDate within the next 7 days; tapping it opens RecurringPaymentsScreen; the 'Upcoming recurring' section is unchanged.

With no pending SMS, no over-budget, and no bills due, no attention cards render and the month strip sits directly under the hero (zone collapses cleanly). Attention order is SMS -> bills due -> budget exceeded.

homeOverviewProvider composes existing providers (no new SQL) into one immutable snapshot; the hero total, this-month strip, and attention zone read from it; number meanings/calculations are unchanged; no-flicker (skipLoadingOnReload-style) behavior is preserved.
No new persisted field, column, table, or migration was introduced.
flutter analyze reports no new errors and flutter test passes (all existing ~103 tests plus the new recurring_due and home_overview unit tests).
findings: Shared balance helper: lib/presentation/screens/settings/account_balance_actions.dart exposes top-level `Future<void> editAccountBalance(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref, AccountModel account)` (reproduces Home's old _editBalance via showFieldsSheet; delegates to homeControllerProvider.updateAccountBalance so the adjustment math is NOT duplicated). Home's hero chip (onEditAccount) and accounts_management_screen.dart row onTap both call it; home_screen.dart's _editBalance method was removed. Bills-due selector in lib/presentation/providers/recurring_providers.dart: `int dueWithinDays(List<RecurringPaymentModel> items, {int days = 7, DateTime? now})` plus list variant `List<RecurringPaymentModel> dueWithinDaysList(List<RecurringPaymentModel> items, {int days = 7, DateTime? now})` (filter isActive && !nextDueDate.isBefore(startOfToday) && !nextDueDate.isAfter(startOfToday+days)). Composed snapshot in lib/presentation/providers/home_overview_provider.dart: immutable class `HomeOverview` with fields {double totalBalance, double monthIncome, double monthExpense, double monthNet, int pendingSmsCount, int billsDueCount, List<BudgetModel> exceededBudgets}; provider name is `homeOverviewProvider` (Provider<HomeOverview>) composing accountListProvider (fold), homeMonthSummaryProvider, smsQueueProvider('detected'), recurringListProvider (via dueWithinDays), budgetListProvider (predicate overAmount>0||usedRatio>=1.0) — no new SQL. Pure combine step extracted as top-level `combineHomeOverview({required List<AccountModel> accounts, required AnalyticsSummaryModel monthSummary, required int pendingSmsCount, required List<RecurringPaymentModel> recurring, required List<BudgetModel> budgets, DateTime? now})` (unit-tested). Home reads the snapshot for hero total (passed into _HeroCard as `total`), attention zone (smsCount/billsDue/exceededBudgets); attention order is SMS -> bills due -> budget exceeded, each conditional with const SizedBox(height:14) separators so the zone still collapses. New _BillsDueAttentionCard (AppCard, 44x44 chip, 'N bills due this week' / 'Tap to review upcoming payments', chevron) navigates AppRoutes.push(RecurringPaymentsScreen). _ThisMonthStrip still reads homeMonthSummaryProvider with .when(skipLoadingOnReload:true) (same provider the snapshot reads) so no-flicker is preserved. Invalidation: NO new invalidation added — transaction_providers._refreshDependents() already loads accountListProvider+budgetListProvider and invalidates homeMonthSummaryProvider, and Home's refresh() reloads account/budget/recurring + invalidates homeMonthSummaryProvider; recurringListProvider and smsQueueProvider are not mutated by transactions so they need no extra invalidation. The composed homeOverviewProvider is a plain Provider that recomputes automatically when any watched source updates. Tests added: test/unit/recurring_due_test.dart (7 cases) and test/unit/home_overview_test.dart (5 cases); flutter analyze clean, full flutter test green (115 passed). No DB migration/schema change.
